code=code.replace('''def pivchol(K, k):
    n=K.shape[0]; d=np.diag(K).copy(); L=np.zeros((n,k)); piv=[]

        j=int(np.argmax(d)); piv.append(j)''','''def pivchol(K, k, tol=1e-8):
    n=K.shape[0]; d=np.diag(K).copy(); L=np.zeros((n,k)); piv=[]
    for i in range(k):
        j=int(np.argmax(d))
        if d[j]<tol*np.diag(K).max():
            rest=[t for t in np.argsort(-np.diag(K)) if t not in set(piv)]
            piv+= rest[:k-len(piv)]; break
        piv.append(j)''')
